build: pipeline test with FIXTURE SDK (not the real SDK)

results.name: Build succeeds for all 12 pages from a manifest-verified fixture
results.actual:
exit 0 porting Wizard _ GaonGreen.html        (no external code)  inline-script hashes=5
built 12 pages -> ../../../tmp/pinned-csJ6sO/out  (sdk 0.0.0-FIXTURE FIXTURE)

results.name: No page references external script/import code, no CDN host, no floating @2 SDK
Every page that uses the SDK loads it with an SRI attribute equal to the sha384 of the vendored file
results.expected: 10 SDK pages, all with matching SRI

results.name: CSP: script-src has no unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval, only self + sha256 hashes; connect-src is self + the one Supabase host
All 12 pages load under their own hash-based CSP: 0 CSP violations, 0 JS errors, 0 external requests
Every page whose code uses window.supabase (including the dynamic-import page) has the library loaded: createClient is a function
Scripts really execute under the CSP: K-RE100 sum 500 and EPR total 50 kg computed
CSP is actually enforced: an injected inline <script> and an inline onerror handler do NOT run and are reported
connect-src blocks a fetch to a non-Supabase host
Nav strip in the pinned build: gg-nav.js/css shipped and hashed in RELEASE_MANIFEST; 10 links render (display flex) on 4 sampled pages with 0 CSP violations
Staging retarget: build succeeds; no page contains the production host or the old key; every page targets the staging host; CSP connect-src allows only it
results.expected: clean retarget, key not echoed in manifest

results.name: Staging retarget REFUSES: production ref (flag and env), secret key, service_role JWT, non-publishable key, http/wrong-domain/short-ref URL, and a lone flag (10 cases); no output written
_headers: baseline hardening headers on /*; every one of the 12 pages has a rule whose CSP equals the page meta CSP plus frame-ancestors 'none'; no unsafe-eval; no unsafe-inline in script-src
results.expected: baseline ok, 12 page rules identical to meta CSP
